subject: Re: limiting a Date range using scale_x_continuous

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: limiting a Date range using scale_x_continuous
parts:
Hi Avram,

You want scale_x_date.

Hadley

On Wed, Jun 2, 2010 at 3:57 PM, Avram Aelony <aav...@mac.com> wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> Usually I subset a data frame before plotting, but in this case I decided to learn to use the "limits" argument for scale_x_continuous.  I ran into a problem, however, when I tried to limit Dates on the x-axis.
>
> g is my graph object.
>
>> g + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(as.Date("20100401","%Y%m%d"), as.Date("20100602","%Y%m%d") ) )
> Error in grid.pretty(range) : 'range' must be numeric
>
>> grid.pretty
> function (range)
> {
>    if (!is.numeric(range))
>        stop("'range' must be numeric")
>    .Call(L_pretty, range)
> }
> <environment: namespace:grid>
>
>
> # I can force the x-axis to be numeric so that grid.pretty won't complain, but then the x-axis is no longer a Date
>> g + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(as.numeric(as.Date("20100401","%Y%m%d")), as.numeric(as.Date("20100602","%Y%m%d")) ) )
> Warning messages:
> 1: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
> 2: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
> 3: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
> 4: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
> 5: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_path).
> 6: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_path).
> 7: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_path).
> 8: Removed 33 rows containing missing values (geom_path).
>
> # I tried to find a "Date" formatter (but there doesn't seem to be one).
>> g + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(as.numeric(as.Date("20100401","%Y%m%d")), as.numeric(as.Date("20100602","%Y%m%d")) ), formatter="Date" )
> Error in get(as.character(FUN), mode = "function", envir = envir) :
>  object 'Date' of mode 'function' was not found
>
>
> # I also tried a "date" formatter (but there doesn't seem to be one)
>> g + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(as.numeric(as.Date("20100401","%Y%m%d")), as.numeric(as.Date("20100602","%Y%m%d")) ), formatter="date" )
> Error in f(unlist(l[numeric])) : unused argument(s) (unlist(l[numeric]))
>
>
> Any ideas appreciated,
>
> -Avram
>
